# Dromaius 0.1.3

- **Automatic updates:** Dromaius checks GitHub releases quietly at startup
  and offers newer versions in an accessible dialog. Windows portable updates
  are downloaded, SHA-256 verified, installed after Dromaius closes, and then
  restarted. On macOS, Dromaius opens the matching release page.
- **Manual update checks:** Choose **Check for Dromaius updates** from the main
  menu at any time.
- **Simpler push to talk:** Focus an Android control and press F7 to hold it
  down. Press F7 again to release it. Shift+F7 is no longer assigned.
